findings.description: Long-lived AWS access key ID and secret access key are embedded in plaintext Lambda environment variables rather than obtained from the function's IAM execution role. Anyone with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration or read access to the state file/repo can retrieve and reuse these credentials.

No kms_key_arn is specified, so environment variables (which here contain secrets) are encrypted only with the default AWS-managed Lambda key, giving no customer-controlled key policy or access separation for the stored secret material.
The function uses nodejs12.x, a runtime that has reached end of life and no longer receives security patches from AWS, leaving the execution environment exposed to unpatched vulnerabilities.
